description: This file defines multiple benchmark classes for tensor broadcasting operations in PyTorch, including specific cases for row, mid, and column broadcasting, as well as a template for elementwise operations with dynamically registered operators.

classes.name: BroadcastMulBench
classes.description: Benchmark class for broadcasting multiplication with different cases (row, mid, col).

classes.name: BroadcastRowBench
classes.description: Specialized benchmark for row broadcasting case.

classes.name: BroadcastMidBench
classes.description: Specialized benchmark for mid broadcasting case.

classes.name: BroadcastColBench
classes.description: Specialized benchmark for column broadcasting case.

classes.name: BroadcastThreeArgs
classes.description: Benchmark class for broadcasting with three arguments.

classes.name: BroadcastBench
classes.description: Template benchmark class for elementwise broadcasting operations with dynamic operator registration.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the broadcasted operation (addition) on inputs.

methods.name: reference
methods.description: Computes the reference result using numpy for validation.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Returns configuration parameters for the benchmark.

methods.name: memory_workload
methods.description: Calculates memory workload for the benchmark.

methods.name: module
methods.description: Returns the module name for the benchmark.
